summary: The tight push-in turns into a wide low-angle shot with a second figure, and the ceiling flickers. There are also a head/arm snap and unlit confetti.

faults.what: Between 123.33 and 123.36 the head turns hard to profile and the torso shifts in one frame. The pointing arm vanishes. This reads as pose snapping with no anticipation.
faults.fix: Add 2-3 in-between frames on the head turn and arm drop, or ease the rotation.

faults.what: Between 123.33 and 123.39 the camera and background jump. The stairs, pillar and turkeys reposition, and the view drops lower and closer to the face within about two frames.
faults.fix: Smooth the camera move over more frames.

faults.what: The framing jumps from a tight close-up at 123.49 to a full-body wide low-angle with a second figure at 123.92. The brief says tight and pushing in, but this is a different shot. The ceiling takes up the top of the frame.
faults.fix: End this shot at the close-up and make the wide its own shot, or keep the push-in continuous.

faults.what: The ceiling at the top of the frame flickers between 123.92 and 124.16. A brown polygon appears and disappears, changing shape and tint (brown at 123.96-124.12, pale at 124.16). It covers a big part of the frame.
faults.fix: Fix the ceiling mesh culling and near clip, and lock the ceiling material.

faults.what: Confetti from the gift box is flat, unshaded coloured squares. They grow fast and cross the second figure from 124.02 to 124.16, and cover more of the frame at 124.36-124.5.
faults.fix: Light or soft-shade the particles, fade them out and reduce density near the dancers.

faults.what: The ceiling changes between brown and pale sky and chandelier across 124.36-124.59. The camera tilts and the ceiling texture swaps.
